name: agent-team
description: Codex coordination for a gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-astra primary with gpt-6.1-terra workers, an Astra critic, and an Astra UI/UX designer.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Terra, Luna, and Astra specialists in Codex.
interface.longDescription: A gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-astra primary routes bounded fact-finding, implementation, and check execution to gpt-6.1-terra, bounded read-only status monitoring to gpt-6-luna, visual and interaction design to Astra, and independent code, plan, architecture, or tradeoff review to an Astra critic. Worker and monitor roles do not perform independent reviews. Reviews are delegated only when useful or requested; the primary retains final acceptance. The separate Luna-primary advisor is outside this plugin. Includes ownership-aware installation of named Codex agents.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-team to coordinate this task with the appropriate specialists.
